name: Velt
source: A prisoner who has awakened in the Tower's prison located in the deepest depths of the Tower. Tall, muscular and blessed with superhuman strength and keen senses. A man of few words and poor at expressing emotions, his personality brooks no despicable nor unjust acts. He's skilled in swordplay but is also capable of wielding other weapons like spears, axes and bows competently. With the sentient Black Blade "Dazrad" he discovered in the Tower in one hand, he seeks the outside world and continues his ascent of the mysterious Tower.
